Ana (Finance): Heads-up — we're rolling out a small change to how metering and soft throttles interact starting next Tuesday. High-level: we are introducing a "soft-throttle" grace window and a clearer invoice line for buffered overage. Goal is to reduce noisy rate-limit escalations for bursty apps while keeping cost signals accurate.

Jordan (Product): TL;DR — will this change how SDKs see 429s?

Ana (Finance): Yes — SDKs may see fewer immediate 429s for brief spikes (<= 30s), but if the burst persists we'll still enforce normal rate limits. We will also add a new invoice field, `grace_used_tokens`, so customers can see how much of the buffered allowance they consumed.

Emma (Support): Need language for customer comms. Do we have a template?

Ana (Finance): Draft coming today. Short version: "We now allow short bursts without immediate throttling; persistent load is unaffected and billed normally. See invoice breakdown for details." Longer FAQ will explain edge cases and how to disable the grace window per-account.

Khalid (Eng): Implementation note: runtime will keep a per-key sliding window counter and only escalate to hard throttle after 30s of sustained over-target QPS. Also adding a metric `soft_throttle_suppressed` (count) and `soft_grace_consumed_tokens`. We'll need to expose these in Console and to the metrics API.

sre-bot: Deployment plan: canary to 10% request volume on Tuesday 03:00 UTC, full rollout by Thursday 18:00 UTC if telemetry looks good. Auto-rollback if error rate increases >0.5% or p50 latency regresses >25ms.

Jordan (Product): Will this affect Dedicated and Private customers?

Ana (Finance): Dedicated customers will get the same soft-grace behavior unless they opt out via account settings. Private/on-prem customers: we will provide config knobs in the next patch but won't force the change.

billing-bot: New invoice example snippet (will appear under "Usage adjustments"):

```
Usage adjustments:
  base_tokens: 12,435,212
  overage_tokens: 1,210
  grace_used_tokens: 320
  billed_overage_tokens: 890
```

Khalid (Eng): One more: please note that `grace_used_tokens` are visible but only billed if overage remains after the grace window; we compute `billed_overage_tokens = max(0, overage_tokens - grace_used_tokens)` as shown.

Emma (Support): I'll prep the KB article and sample customer messages. Requesting the final FAQ by Monday EOD so we can coordinate a support playbook.

Ana (Finance): Sounds good. Action items: 1) Jordan — approve customer-facing copy by Mon 12:00 PT; 2) Khalid — telemetry dashboards + metrics API by deploy canary; 3) Emma — KB + playbook draft. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup: 

Jordan (Product): Approved for copy review. :ok_hand:

Khalid (Eng): Working on dashboards, will post links once ready.

sre-bot: Canary scheduled for Tue 03:00 UTC. Will post deployment thread.

billing-bot: Reminder: invoice schema change will ship with the billing API v1.3; API clients using strict schema validation may need a patch.

Emma (Support): Got it — leaving this thread open for updates.

Ana (Finance): Thanks team — keeping this light-touch for customers but much clearer internally.
